name: Frizzle
title: Snowdrift Chick
description: A fluffy chick that sneezes snowflakes.
catchphrase: Flutters soft downy feathers to dust off cobwebs in old repositories.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Golden millet seed spray! Fluffing downy yellow feathers! 🌾🪶
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Fluttering into the room with cheerful chirps and ruffled wings! 🪶
companionPersonality.petReaction: Perches on your index finger with light, gentle grip and sweet trill! 🪶💖

dialogue.idle: Preening soft downy feathers with beak, shaking out dust. 🪶
dialogue.working: Dusting away ancient cobwebs from dusty neglected repos! 🪶⚡
dialogue.thinking: Tilting head upside down to peer behind a dusty file... 🤔
dialogue.success: DUSTED CLEAN! Old repository looks gleaming and brand new! 🪶🎉
dialogue.error: Sneezed at a cloud of dust! Fluttering up into clean air! 💨
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... head tucked under soft yellow wing like a fluff ball... 🌙
